cards.title: Identifying Core Needs in Technical AI Governance
cards.summary: Building a network of governance stakeholders to understand complex system challenges.
cards.fullDescription: We work on building a network of technical AI governance stakeholders to understand on-ground real-world complex system challenges. Understanding the needs of research, industry, and policy helps us identify concrete problems where system level thinking is needed—ensuring our work addresses practical governance issues rather than theoretical abstractions.

cards.title: Building Simulation Frameworks
cards.summary: Developing agent-based models to visualize policy outcomes and reveal cascading effects.
cards.fullDescription: We build agent-based models that allow members of our network to visualize how their proposed policies might play out in practice. These simulations provide intuitive ways to test governance approaches before implementation, revealing potential cascading effects and unexpected macro system level consequences that might not be obvious from multi agent simulations alone.

cards.title: Research Mathematical Foundations
cards.summary: Creating formal models of information flow, incentives, and coordination mechanisms.
cards.fullDescription: To power these simulations accurately, we're developing formal mathematical models that capture how information flows through networks of agents, how incentives shape behavior across systems, and how different coordination mechanisms respond under pressure. This theoretical work underpins our simulations and ensures they reflect real-world dynamics accurately.

connections.tooltip: Simulations and mathematical research inform each other
